typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	AggFact_DataQuery as string (),
	Dw_Run_Key as integer ()
}

source(output(
		HolderNo as string,
		HolderName as string,
		IODate as timestamp,
		oooioentry_iotime as timestamp,
		IODatetime1 as timestamp,
		IODatetime2 as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT  HolderNo,HolderName,i.IODate,convert(datetime,i.IODate+\' \'+i.IOTime) IODatetime1,convert(datetime,i.IODate+\' \'+i.IOTime) IODatetime2,min(o.iotime) oooioentry_iotime FROM   stg_iodata i (nolock)        LEFT OUTER JOIN oooioentry o  (nolock)          on i.holdername = o.employeename                    and convert(datetime,i.iodate+ \' \' +i.iotime) >=  convert(datetime,convert(varchar(50),o.iodate,112) + \' 00:00:00\' )                   and convert(datetime,i.iodate+ \' \' +i.iotime) <= (case when o.iotime < convert(datetime,convert(varchar(50),o.iodate,112) + \' 22:00:00\' ) then o.iotime + 1 else o.iotime end)             AND reason = \'Final Exit\'  where i.dw_run_key = 111 group by HolderNo,HolderName,i.IODate,convert(datetime,i.IODate+\' \'+i.IOTime)  ORDER  BY HolderName,CONVERT(DATETIME, i.iodate+\' \'+i.iotime)',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> DFTAGGFACT	source(output(
		Dw_Holder_Key as integer,
		Holder_Number as string,
		DW_Create_Dt as timestamp,
		Holder_Name as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT     Dw_Holder_Key, CONVERT(VARCHAR(50),CONVERT(INT,Holder_Number))Holder_Number, DW_Create_Dt, Holder_Name FROM         dbo.DIM_HOLDER',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LKPDIMHOLDERLKPTABLE
DFTAGGFACT,LKPDIMHOLDERLKPTABLE lookup(HolderNo == Holder_Number,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LKPDIMHOLDER
LKPDIMHOLDER filter(isMatch()) ~> LKPDIMHOLDER0
LKPDIMHOLDER0 derive(Dw_Run_Key = $Dw_Run_Key,
		CreateDt = currentDate(),
		Dw_Holder_Key = iif(isNull(Dw_Holder_Key), -(2), Dw_Holder_Key)) ~> AGGFACTDRVCOL
AGGFACTDRVCOL split(isNull(oooioentry_iotime), disjoint: true) ~> CSSHIFTRECORDS@(RegularShift,NightShift)
CSSHIFTRECORDS@RegularShift aggregate(groupBy(IODate,Dw_Run_Key,Dw_Holder_Key,CreateDt),
	InDatetime = min(IODatetime2),
		OutDatetime = max(IODatetime1)) ~> AGGREGREC
CSSHIFTRECORDS@NightShift aggregate(groupBy(oooioentry_iotime,Dw_Holder_Key,Dw_Run_Key,CreateDt),
	InDatetime = min(IODatetime1),
		OutDatetime = max(IODatetime2)) ~> AGGNIGREC
AGGREGREC sink(input(
		DW_Holder_Key as integer,
		DW_Create_Dt as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		OutDateTime as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		DW_Run_Key as integer,
		InDateTime as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		DW_Holder_Key = Dw_Holder_Key,
		DW_Create_Dt = CreateDt,
		OutDateTime = OutDatetime,
		DW_Run_Key,
		InDateTime = InDatetime)) ~> AGGFACTDST1
AGGNIGREC sink(input(
		DW_Holder_Key as integer,
		DW_Create_Dt as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		OutDateTime as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		DW_Run_Key as integer,
		InDateTime as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		DW_Holder_Key = Dw_Holder_Key,
		DW_Create_Dt = CreateDt,
		OutDateTime = OutDatetime,
		DW_Run_Key = Dw_Run_Key,
		InDateTime = InDatetime)) ~> AGGFACTDST
